checks: Clicking a real battle-list target leaves the wand idle and the main action ready, even after a full round.
Keyboard 4 casts three Magic Missiles immediately on the selected monster; no prior Spark and no double action.
Hotbar click queues Frost Ray and shows a countdown; reselecting the same monster does not erase the command.
Movement keeps working while a targeted spell is pending.
Holding Space while the queued spell becomes ready does not steal its action; Frost Ray casts once, costs no mana and clears its queue display.
The wand does not resume automatic sparks after a cast or an idle interval.
Manual Space still fires a 1d4 Spark; clearing the target cancels a subsequent queue without spending mana.
F casts the actual most-used/recent tied spell into the selected target without a wand attack.
The favorite F button displays the same server-confirmed queue countdown.
The second hotbar row (F1) uses the same target and queue rules.
Casting from the spellbook retains the enemy, acknowledges the pending cast and refreshes after it executes.
390x844: tapping the hotbar queues and casts without horizontal page overflow.
844x390: tapping the hotbar queues and casts without horizontal page overflow.
Choosing a genuinely different target cancels the previous queue and never transfers a paid spell silently.
The on-screen Attack button also retains the explicit manual Spark.
No JavaScript exceptions; all actions used production UI and actual server handlers.
connection: controlled Python WebSocket bridge to real aiohttp server; native Chromium loopback denied by environment
monster_ai: paused; deterministic clock; actual production player action loop
